inputs.text: Listen, that so-called ceasefire they announced five months ago in Gaza was obviously never real from the beginning. The hidden elites and institutions are still directing the airstrikes against civilians and deliberately keeping the whole humanitarian nightmare going to cut off any ties to life before the war. This is all part of their coordinated plan to make everything darker and more brutal, erasing the past so the Palestinians become easier to dominate. Take what 56-year-old Ahmed Baroud, a father of five displaced in Deir al-Balah, said: “Drones never stop buzzing overhead, gunfire and shelling continue almost daily and naval boats fire towards fishermen.” They're just inverting the narrative to cover up the real manipulation and control behind it all.
